featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 与 WorkBuddy 的本地看板及用量洞察。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added local dashboards and usage insights for Codex, Claude Code, Grok, and WorkBuddy.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增基于 Hooks 的 AI 监控、状态工作台与本地图片管理。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added Hook-based AI monitoring, status workbench, and local image management.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 12 个纯位置编号的桌宠浮窗，以及拖拽、布局、分页和托盘控制。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a 12-position desktop pet overlay with dragging, layouts, paging, and tray controls.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一看板与监控的 AI 能力目录，仅展示各界面实际支持的类型。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unified dashboard and monitor AI capabilities so each surface exposes only supported types.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 对齐 AIMonitorDesktop 的 Hook 拦截与会话生命周期，修复部分 AI 消息无法监听的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Aligned Hook interception and session lifecycle with AIMonitorDesktop to capture previously missed AI events.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠冷启动占位、位置绑定、托盘显隐和隐藏协议残留问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed desktop pet cold-start placeholders, position binding, tray visibility, and hidden-protocol remnants.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复应用包版本和 DMG 安装布局与根版本及 GUI Profile 不一致的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed app bundle version and DMG installation layout drift from the root version and GUI profile.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠设置窗关闭后的 WebView 占用，并让测试专用性能采集在窗口隐藏时停止逐帧运行。
bugFixes.en-US: Removed pet-settings WebView overhead after close and stopped test-only performance capture while the window is hidden.
